author.zh: 罗伯特·路易斯·史蒂文森

edition.en: A Child’s Garden of Verses (1885), on Project Gutenberg (eBook 136)
edition.zh: 据古登堡计划电子书 136 所录《一个孩子的诗园》（1885）

basis.en: Published in 1885; the author died in 1894.
basis.zh: 1885 年出版；作者卒于 1894 年。

note.en: A child watches Leerie the lamplighter come up the street at teatime and decides that, of all trades, that is the one to choose. Stevenson, often kept indoors by illness as a child, wrote many of these poems from inside, looking out. For a library that keeps lamps lit, it is close to a job description.
note.zh: 一个孩子在下午茶时分看着点灯人利里沿街走来，决定在所有行当里就选这一个。史蒂文森小时候常因生病被关在屋里，这本诗集有许多篇都是从屋里往外望着写的。对一座让灯一直亮着的图书馆来说，这几乎就是一份岗位说明。

excerpt.orig: O Leerie, I’ll go round at night and light the lamps with you!
excerpt.en: O Leerie, I’ll go round at night and light the lamps with you!
excerpt.zh: 哦，利里，我要在夜里跟你一起，到处去点灯！
